decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith GP-0608-001, Design and Access Statement, Received 17 April 2013 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 3 - No additional fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - For noise emitted from fixed plant on the site the rating level shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.
description: Erection of extractor system to the side of the premises
